# System Architecture

| Component | Module | Role |
|-----------|--------|------|
| TDD Cycle | `IterativeTDDRunner` | Orchestrates the outer RED→GREEN→REFACTOR loop across multiple increments |
| TDD Cycle | `TDDCycleRunner` | Executes one complete TDD cycle (RED→GREEN→REFACTOR) with retries and learning |
| TDD Cycle | `IncrementalPlanner` | Determines the next test increment using LLM and playbook context |
| TDD Cycle | `PythonLanguagePod` | LanguagePod implementation for Python: delegates code gen to WorkerAgent, execution to PodmanOrchestrator |
| TDD Cycle | `GoLanguagePod` | LanguagePod implementation for Go TDD cycles |
| TDD Cycle | `TypeScriptLanguagePod` | LanguagePod implementation for TypeScript TDD cycles |
| TDD Cycle | `WorkerAgent` | Generates code for RED/GREEN/REFACTOR phases using LLM and playbook bullets |
| TDD Cycle | `TypeScriptWorkerAgent` | TypeScript-specific code generation agent |
| TDD Cycle | `PodmanOrchestrator` | Stateless sidecar execution layer; verifies workspace hash for security |
| TDD Cycle | `PodmanRunner` | Rootless Podman container runner for isolated test execution |
| TDD Cycle | `GoRunner` | PodmanRunner pre-configured for Go harness image |
| TDD Cycle | `TypeScriptRunner` | PodmanRunner pre-configured for TypeScript harness image |
| TDD Cycle | `ImportFilter` | Static analysis filter that rejects forbidden imports and builtins |
| TDD Cycle | `RedundancyPreChecker` | Pre-checks proposed tests for redundancy before RED phase |
| TDD Cycle | `TestReviewAgent` | Validates test quality before implementation |
| TDD Cycle | `GherkinFeatureBridge` | Parses Gherkin .feature files into FeatureSpec |
| TDD Cycle | `GherkinExtractionAgent` | Reverse-engineers Gherkin scenarios from existing code and tests |
| TDD Cycle | `PolyglotTDDRunner` | Drives RED→GREEN→REFACTOR across multiple LanguagePods for comparison |
| TDD Cycle | `EnsembleBuildRunner` | Multi-candidate blind build for one feature across models |
| Core | `Reflector` | Analyzes task outcomes, extracts error patterns and root causes |
| Core | `Curator` | Synthesizes reflector insights into playbook delta bullets |
| Core | `Generator` | Executes tasks using playbook-guided LLM with bullet retrieval |
| Playbook | `PlaybookManager` | Manages playbook CRUD, delta updates, deduplication, and persistence |
| Playbook | `BulletRetriever` | Hybrid retrieval engine for selecting relevant bullets |
| Playbook | `BulletDeduplicator` | Semantic deduplication of bullets using embedding similarity |
| Playbook | `BulletClusterer` | DBSCAN clustering for playbook bullets |
| Playbook | `DistillationRouter` | Routes tasks to domain-specific distillation playbooks |
| Playbook | `PlaybookQA` | Answers coding questions using playbook knowledge |
| Playbook | `MarkdownImporter` | Batch imports knowledge from markdown files |
| Playbook | `PostgresPlaybookAdapter` | PostgreSQL-backed playbook manager |
| Playbook | `PostgresBulletRetriever` | PostgreSQL-backed retrieval using pgvector |
| Audit | `AuditStore` | Append-only audit event store with hash chain integrity |
| Audit | `AuditClient` | Write-only HTTP audit client for agents |
| Audit | `LocalAuditClient` | Direct-to-SQLite audit client for development |
| Audit | `AuditDashboard` | Analyzes audit data for agent performance and cost |
| Broker | `AdaptiveBroker` | Routes tasks to best agent based on historical performance |
| Broker | `PerformanceAggregator` | Extracts metrics from audit trail for agent scoring |
| Broker | `CapabilityRegistry` | Tracks anonymous agent capabilities and proficiency |
| Broker | `BrokerAdvisor` | Recommends agents by capability fit |
| Broker | `FeedbackCollector` | Stores human ratings and computes blended/drift scores |
| Broker | `RegressionDetector` | Detects quality regressions across model versions |
| Benchmark | `BlindEvaluator` | Scores outputs without knowing which agent produced them |
| Benchmark | `ModelAttributionTracker` | Tracks OpenRouter model attribution in performance metrics |
| Benchmark | `ProductionDataAnalyzer` | Analyzes production experiment logs for quality metrics |
| Benchmark | `SemanticCodeAnalyzer` | Detects dangerous patterns (eval, exec, secrets) in code |
| Contracts | `ContractArchitect` | Generates contracts from natural language requirements |
| Contracts | `ContractDecomposer` | Breaks user specs into interface contracts |
| Contracts | `ContractOrchestrator` | Orchestrates contract-driven development with validation |
| Contracts | `ModuleArchitect` | Generates module-level contracts for stateful systems |
| Contracts | `ModuleTDDBuilder` | Builds module implementations using TDD methodology |
| Contracts | `ProjectArchitect` | Decomposes project spec into module DAG |
| Ensemble | `EnsembleLearner` | Orchestrates multiple models learning in parallel with voting |
| Ensemble | `ConsensusBuilder` | Builds consensus from multiple model proposals |
| Ensemble | `VotingSystem` | Applies voting strategies (majority, supermajority, weighted, etc.) |
| ML | `MLExperimentKnowledge` | Knowledge base for ML experiments integrating with MLflow |
| ML | `ACEMLflowCallback` | Captures ACE knowledge during MLflow experiments |
| ML | `MLflowKnowledgeQuery` | Unified interface to query MLflow runs with ACE knowledge |
| Retrieval | `ContextGraphRetriever` | CGR³: Context Graph Retrieve-Rank-Reason pipeline |
| Retrieval | `ContextScorer` | Scores bullets against request context across multiple dimensions |
| Retrieval | `InstitutionalKnowledgeService` | Central knowledge retrieval service for all code generation |
| Storage | `ExperimentLogger` | Unified logger for TDD and ML experiments with PostgreSQL/SQLite fallback |
| Storage | `PlaybookRepository` | PostgreSQL repository with pgvector for semantic search |
| CLI | `TDDRunHandle` | Owns sandbox container lifecycle for one `ace tdd` invocation |
| CLI | `ProjectBuilder` | Builds every module of a ProjectPlan in dependency order |
| CLI | `ProjectConfig` | Loads .ace/config.yaml and auto-detects project layout |
| Utilities | `LLMClient` | Unified LLM client supporting multiple providers (OpenRouter, OpenAI, etc.) |
| Utilities | `ClaudeCliClient` | LLM client backed by local `claude -p` CLI |
| Utilities | `EffGenClient` | Adapter for effGen local models |
| Utilities | `EmbeddingService` | Local embedding generation using sentence-transformers |
| Utilities | `ContextMap` | AST-based context map for code generation |
| Utilities | `ContextMapBuilder` | Builds ContextMap from source files |
| Utilities | `ImportValidator` | Validates and corrects import paths in generated code |
| Utilities | `PlaybookEnforcer` | Enforces high-frequency feedback rules (e.g., ace-006) |
| Utilities | `SessionLog` | Tracks edits and tests in current session |
| Utilities | `FileLockContext` | Detects inadvertent drift in target files during a session |
| Utilities | `DriftDetector` | Measures file drift for lock context |
| Utilities | `CostQualityAnalyzer` | Analyzes cost-quality tradeoffs for model performance data |
| Utilities | `SuccessRateCalculator` | Measures experiment success rates across the system |
| Utilities | `TokenEfficiencyReporter` | Computes token efficiency scores from LanguagePod run data |
| Utilities | `TDDCycleAnalyzer` | Measures first-pass GREEN rate and trend over time |
| Utilities | `PlaybookReliabilityAnalyzer` | Correlates bullet retrieval with first-pass GREEN outcomes |
| Utilities | `TDDFailureRecorder` | Records TDD failures and interventions for self-improvement |
| Utilities | `TDDLessonInjector` | Injects TDD lessons into agent prompts based on phase |
| Utilities | `LessonExtractor` | Extracts TDD lessons from resolved beads issues |

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant main
    participant IterativeTDDRunner
    participant IncrementalPlanner
    participant TDDCycleRunner
    participant PythonLanguagePod
    participant WorkerAgent
    participant LLMClient
    participant PodmanOrchestrator
    participant PodmanRunner
    participant Reflector
    participant Curator
    participant PlaybookManager
    participant AuditClient

    main->>IterativeTDDRunner: run_from_feature(feature_path)
    activate IterativeTDDRunner
    loop for each cycle (max iterations)
        IterativeTDDRunner->>IncrementalPlanner: next_increment(requirement, cycle)
        activate IncrementalPlanner
        IncrementalPlanner->>LLMClient: generate(prompt)
        LLMClient-->>IncrementalPlanner: response
        IncrementalPlanner-->>IterativeTDDRunner: TestIncrement
        deactivate IncrementalPlanner

        IterativeTDDRunner->>TDDCycleRunner: run(spec)
        activate TDDCycleRunner

        Note over TDDCycleRunner: RED phase
        TDDCycleRunner->>PythonLanguagePod: run_red(spec)
        activate PythonLanguagePod
        PythonLanguagePod->>WorkerAgent: generate_test(spec)
        activate WorkerAgent
        WorkerAgent->>LLMClient: generate(prompt)
        LLMClient-->>WorkerAgent: code
        WorkerAgent-->>PythonLanguagePod: test_code
        deactivate WorkerAgent
        PythonLanguagePod->>PodmanOrchestrator: pulse(files)
        activate PodmanOrchestrator
        PodmanOrchestrator->>PodmanRunner: send_pulse(files)
        activate PodmanRunner
        PodmanRunner-->>PodmanOrchestrator: PhaseResult
        deactivate PodmanRunner
        PodmanOrchestrator-->>PythonLanguagePod: PhaseResult
        deactivate PodmanOrchestrator
        PythonLanguagePod-->>TDDCycleRunner: PhaseResult
        deactivate PythonLanguagePod

        alt RED aborted or never pulsed
            TDDCycleRunner-->>IterativeTDDRunner: CycleResult(success=False)
        else RED passed
            Note over TDDCycleRunner: GREEN phase (with retries)
            loop up to max_green_attempts
                TDDCycleRunner->>PythonLanguagePod: run_green(spec)
                activate PythonLanguagePod
                PythonLanguagePod->>WorkerAgent: generate_implementation(spec)
                activate WorkerAgent
                WorkerAgent->>LLMClient: generate(prompt)
                LLMClient-->>WorkerAgent: code
                WorkerAgent-->>PythonLanguagePod: impl_code
                deactivate WorkerAgent
                PythonLanguagePod->>PodmanOrchestrator: pulse(files)
                activate PodmanOrchestrator
                PodmanOrchestrator->>PodmanRunner: send_pulse(files)
                PodmanRunner-->>PodmanOrchestrator: PhaseResult
                deactivate PodmanOrchestrator
                PythonLanguagePod-->>TDDCycleRunner: PhaseResult
                deactivate PythonLanguagePod
                alt GREEN passed or abort
                    break
                else
                    Note right of TDDCycleRunner: retry with error feedback
                end
            end

            alt GREEN failed
                TDDCycleRunner-->>IterativeTDDRunner: CycleResult(success=False)
            else GREEN passed
                Note over TDDCycleRunner: REFACTOR phase
                TDDCycleRunner->>PythonLanguagePod: run_refactor(spec)
                activate PythonLanguagePod
                PythonLanguagePod->>WorkerAgent: generate_refactor(spec)
                activate WorkerAgent
                WorkerAgent->>LLMClient: generate(prompt)
                LLMClient-->>WorkerAgent: code
                WorkerAgent-->>PythonLanguagePod: refactored_code
                deactivate WorkerAgent
                PythonLanguagePod->>PodmanOrchestrator: pulse(files)
                activate PodmanOrchestrator
                PodmanOrchestrator->>PodmanRunner: send_pulse(files)
                PodmanRunner-->>PodmanOrchestrator: PhaseResult
                deactivate PodmanOrchestrator
                PythonLanguagePod-->>TDDCycleRunner: PhaseResult
                deactivate PythonLanguagePod

                Note over TDDCycleRunner: Learning loop
                TDDCycleRunner->>Reflector: reflect(task, gen_output, env_feedback)
                activate Reflector
                Reflector->>LLMClient: generate(prompt)
                LLMClient-->>Reflector: analysis
                Reflector-->>TDDCycleRunner: ReflectorOutput
                deactivate Reflector
                TDDCycleRunner->>Curator: curate(reflector_output, playbook_id)
                activate Curator
                Curator->>LLMClient: generate(prompt)
                LLMClient-->>Curator: synthesis
                Curator->>PlaybookManager: apply_delta(playbook_id, delta_bullets)
                activate PlaybookManager
                PlaybookManager-->>Curator: added_bullets
                deactivate PlaybookManager
                Curator-->>TDDCycleRunner: CuratorOutput
                deactivate Curator

                TDDCycleRunner->>AuditClient: emit_simple(PATTERN_LEARNED, ...)
                TDDCycleRunner-->>IterativeTDDRunner: CycleResult(success=True)
            end
        end
        deactivate TDDCycleRunner

        alt planner says COMPLETE
            Note right of IterativeTDDRunner: exit loop
            break
        end
    end
    IterativeTDDRunner-->>main: IterativeResult
    deactivate IterativeTDDRunner
```
